## Purpose and deployable surfaces
This repository contains an open-source framework-agnostic JavaScript mind-map engine plus a Vue 2 browser editor built on it. The engine is published from `simple-mind-map/index.js` (with `simple-mind-map/full.js` as a broader bundle entry); the application starts at `web/src/main.js` and mounts `web/src/App.vue`. Prebuilt static output is committed under `dist/` and can be served through `nginx.conf` or `Dockerfile`.

## Application shell and editor orchestration
Vue provides routing, global state, localization, and the editor workspace. `web/src/router.js` selects document/editor pages; `web/src/store.js` holds UI/application state; `web/src/pages/Edit/Index.vue` composes the interactive editor. `web/src/pages/Edit/components/Edit.vue` is the main boundary between UI controls and the mind-map library, while toolbars, sidebars, import/export, and context menus invoke library APIs.

## Core mind-map runtime
The library’s core coordinates stateful editing, events, rendering, and viewport behavior:
- `simple-mind-map/src/core/command/Command.js`
- `simple-mind-map/src/core/event/Event.js`
- `simple-mind-map/src/core/render/Render.js`
- `simple-mind-map/src/core/view/View.js`

Commands mediate mutations and keyboard actions; events distribute interaction/lifecycle signals; rendering transforms map data into visual nodes and connections; the view manages canvas/SVG viewport navigation such as pan and zoom.

## Node model, visual construction, and editing
Node rendering is decomposed into a central node object plus shape, style, layout, content, expansion, and interaction concerns. Key paths are:
- `simple-mind-map/src/core/render/node/MindMapNode.js`
- `simple-mind-map/src/core/render/node/Shape.js`
- `simple-mind-map/src/core/render/node/Style.js`

This is the primary boundary where structured node data and theme/options become editable visual objects. `TextEdit.js` handles in-place text editing, while node command wrappers and cooperative helpers connect visual actions back to command-driven state changes.

## Layout and presentation pipeline
Layouts calculate node positions and connector geometry independently of the UI. The shared contract begins at `simple-mind-map/src/layouts/Base.js`; concrete topology implementations include:
- `simple-mind-map/src/layouts/MindMap.js`
- `simple-mind-map/src/layouts/LogicalStructure.js`
- `simple-mind-map/src/layouts/Fishbone.js`

The render pipeline selects a layout based on map options, computes placement, then renders nodes/lines. Themes provide the default visual policy through `simple-mind-map/src/theme/index.js` and `simple-mind-map/src/theme/default.js`.

## Extensibility, formats, and integrations
Optional capabilities are library plugins, installed by consumers rather than embedded in core. Architecturally significant plugins include interaction/export and rich map annotations:
- `simple-mind-map/src/plugins/Drag.js`
- `simple-mind-map/src/plugins/Export.js`
- `simple-mind-map/src/plugins/ExportXMind.js`

Import/export converters form a separate data boundary for Markdown, text, and XMind: `simple-mind-map/src/parse/markdown.js`, `simple-mind-map/src/parse/toMarkdown.js`, and `simple-mind-map/src/parse/xmind.js`. The Vue app exposes these through `web/src/pages/Edit/components/Import.vue` and `web/src/pages/Edit/components/Export.vue`.

## Runtime boundaries and external services
The shipped product is a client-side web application: browser DOM/canvas/SVG APIs, Vue 2, and Element UI are material runtime dependencies. There is no server implementation in this tree. `web/src/api/index.js` and AI-facing UI (`web/src/pages/Edit/components/AiChat.vue`, `AiCreate.vue`) represent an outbound API boundary; deployment is static assets behind Nginx. Closed-source desktop, Obsidian, and uTools products referenced by the README are not implemented here.
